la: Deus, virginitátis amátor et custos: cujus múnere fámula tua Margaríta virginitátis decórem mérito bonórum óperum sociávit; concéde, quǽsumus, ut mentis integritátem spíritu salutáris pæniténtiæ restauráre possímus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, the loving guardian of virginity, by whose grace Your handmaid Margaret united to the beauty of virginity the merit of good works; grant, we beseech You, that in the spirit of saving penance we may be able to restore integrity of mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Hæc obláta, quǽsumus, Dómine, miserátus inténde et, intercedénte beáta Margaríta, quam pæniténtiæ víctimam pro salúte suæ gentis fíeri voluísti, humáno géneri pacem in caritáte Christi placátus concéde: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, O Lord, look mercifully on these offerings and, by the intercession of blessed Margaret, whom You willed to be made a victim of penance for the salvation of her people, be appeased and grant to the human race peace in the charity of Christ; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Refécti, Dómine, mensa cælésti, te súpplices exorámus: ut, beátæ Margarítæ exémplo prætereúntem hujus mundi contemnéntes figúram; ad ætérna mereámur gáudia perveníre: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Refreshed, O Lord, at the heavenly table, we humbly beseech You that, by the example of blessed Margaret despising the fashion of this world which passes away, we may deserve to arrive at eternal joys; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátum Raymúndum pœniténtiæ Sacraménti insígnem minístrum elegísti; et per maris undas mirabíliter traduxísti: concéde, ut ejus intercessióne dignos pœniténtiæ fructus fácere; et ad ætérnæ salútis portum perveníre valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who chose blessed Raymond to be a renowned minister of the sacrament of penance, and wondrously brought him across the waves of the sea; grant that through his intercession we may bring forth worthy fruits of penance and be able to reach the haven of eternal salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Múnera, Dómine, majestáti tuæ obláta sanctífica, et intercedénte beáto Raymúndo Confessóre tuo, auxílium nobis tuæ defensiónis impénde. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts offered to Your majesty; and through the intercession of blessed Raymond, Your confessor, bestow on us the help of Your protection; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut sancti Raymúndi Confessóris tui celebráta solémnitas; nobis indulgéntiam peccatórum, et glóriam ætérnæ felicitátis acquírat: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, O Lord our God, that the feast of Saint Raymond, Your confessor, which we have celebrated, may obtain for us pardon of our sins and the glory of eternal happiness; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui univérsum mundum beáti Pauli Apóstoli prædicatióne docuísti: da nobis, quǽsumus, ut qui ejus hódie Conversiónem cólimus; per ejus ad te exémpla gradiámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who taught the whole world by the preaching of blessed Paul the apostle; grant, we beseech You, that we who this day keep his conversion may come to You by following his example; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Apóstoli tui Pauli précibus, Dómine, plebis tuæ dona sanctífica: ut quæ tibi tuo grata sunt institúto, gratióra fiant patrocínio supplicántis. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Through the prayers of Your apostle Paul sanctify the gifts of Your people, O Lord; that what is pleasing to You by Your own institution may become yet more pleasing through the patronage of his pleading; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sanctificáti, Dómine, salutári mystério: quǽsumus, ut nobis ejus non desit orátio; cujus nos donásti patrocínio gubernári: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Hallowed by the saving mystery, O Lord, we beseech You that his prayers may never fail us, under whose patronage You have granted us to be governed; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Da, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui beáti Ignátii Mártyris tui atque Pontíficis solémnia cólimus; ejus apud te intercessiónibus adjuvémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who keep the feast of blessed Ignatius, Your martyr and bishop, may be helped by his intercession with You; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Hæc hóstia, quǽsumus Dómine, emúndet nostra delícta: et ad sacrifícium celebrándum, subditórum tibi córpora mentésque sanctíficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May this victim, we beseech You, O Lord, cleanse away our sins, and hallow the bodies and souls of Your servants for the offering of this sacrifice; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Refécti participatióne múneris sacri, quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut cujus exséquimur cultum; intercedénte beáto Ignátio Mártyre tuo atque Pontífice, sentiámus efféctum: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Refreshed by partaking of this sacred gift, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that through the intercession of blessed Ignatius, Your martyr and bishop, we may feel the effect of the rite we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui inter cétera poténtiæ tuæ mirácula, étiam in sexu frágili victóriam martýrii contulísti: concéde propítius, ut qui beátæ Agathæ Vírginis et Mártyris tuæ natalítia cólimus; per ejus ad te exémpla gradiámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who among the other wonders of Your power have bestowed even on the weaker sex the victory of martyrdom; mercifully grant that we who keep the heavenly birthday of blessed Agatha, Your virgin and martyr, may come to You by following her example; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Súscipe Dómine múnera, quæ in beátæ Agathæ Vírginis et Mártyris tuæ solemnitáte deférimus: cujus nos confídimus patrocínio liberári. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Receive, O Lord, the gifts which we offer on the feast of blessed Agatha, Your virgin and martyr, by whose patronage we trust to be delivered; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Auxiliéntur nobis, Dómine, sumpta mystéria; et intercedénte beáta Agatha Vírgine et Mártyre tua, sempitérna protectióne confírment: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May the mysteries received, O Lord, be a help to us; and through the intercession of blessed Agatha, Your virgin and martyr, may they strengthen us with unfailing protection; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui ánimam beátæ Vírginis tuæ Scholásticæ, ad ostendéndam innocéntiæ viam, in colúmbæ spécie cælum penetráre fecísti: da nobis ejus méritis et précibus, ita innocénter vívere; ut ad ætérna mereámur gáudia perveníre: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who, to show forth the way of innocence, caused the soul of Your blessed virgin Scholastica to enter heaven in the likeness of a dove; grant us by her merits and prayers so to live in innocence that we may deserve to attain to eternal joys; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Accépta tibi sit, Dómine, sacrátæ plebis oblátio pro tuórum honóre Sanctórum, quorum se méritis de tribulatióne percepísse cognóscit auxílium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: ejus, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Dómine Jesu Christe, qui beátam Catharínam Vírginem tui amóre succénsam, passiónis contemplatióne claréscere voluísti: ejus intercessióne concéde, ut passiónis mystéria devóte recoléntes; ejus fructum percípere mereámur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O Lord Jesus Christ, who willed that blessed Catherine, Your virgin, on fire with Your love, should shine forth by the contemplation of Your passion; grant through her intercession that we, devoutly recalling the mysteries of Your passion, may deserve to gather its fruit; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Fac, quǽsumus Dómine, holocáusti tui in ara crucis obláti nos esse partícipes: in cujus sacrosáncti mystérii contemplatióne beátam Catharínam Vírginem tuam mirábilem effecísti. Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Make us, we beseech You, O Lord, partakers of Your holocaust offered on the altar of the cross, by the contemplation of which most holy mystery You made blessed Catherine, Your virgin, wonderful; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens et miséricors Deus: ut nos hæc, quæ súmpsimus, ineffábilis amóris pígnora, ad te redamándum inflámment; atque beátæ Catharínæ Vírginis intercessióne et exémplo, in tua semper dilectióne vivámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty and merciful God, that these pledges of ineffable love which we have received may inflame us to love You in return; and that by the intercession and example of blessed Catherine, Your virgin, we may ever live in Your love; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui salútis animárum zelo, et ampliándæ Religiónis grátia beátum Jordánum mirábilem effecísti: ejus intercedéntibus méritis, fac nos in eódem semper spíritu vívere; ac repósitam in cælis glóriam inveníre: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who made blessed Jordan wonderful in zeal for the salvation of souls and by the grace of spreading the Order; by his merits and intercession grant that we may always live in the same spirit and find the glory laid up for us in heaven; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Cæléstis convívii munus quod offérimus, beátus Jordánus in conspéctu majestátis tuæ, Dómine, præséntet: et dignáre, ut sicut illi confert ad glóriam, ita per ipsíus suffrágium pignus veræ viæ, et vitæ sempitérnæ nobis efficiátur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May blessed Jordan, O Lord, present in the sight of Your majesty the gift of the heavenly banquet which we offer; and vouchsafe that, as it brings him glory, so through his intercession it may become for us the pledge of the true way and of everlasting life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Ætérnæ salútis spes, quam per Córporis et Sánguinis tui, Dómine, perceptiónem habére nos voluísti, secúra permáneat; et beáti Iordáni precátio ad glóriam capesséndam sit semper intercéssio salutáris: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May the hope of eternal salvation which You have willed us to have through receiving Your Body and Blood, O Lord, remain secure; and may the prayer of blessed Jordan ever be a saving intercession for us to win glory; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátam Francíscam fámulam tuam, inter cétera grátiæ tuæ dona, familiári Angeli consuetúdine decorásti: concéde quǽsumus; ut intercessiónis ejus auxílio, Angelórum consórtium cónsequi mereámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who among the other gifts of Your grace honored blessed Frances, Your handmaid, with the familiar companionship of an angel; grant, we beseech You, that by the help of her intercession we may deserve to attain the fellowship of the angels; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Múnera, Dómine, nostræ devotiónis offérimus: ut tibi grata, et nobis salutária beátæ Francíscæ pia supplicatióne reddántur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that through the holy pleading of blessed Frances they may become pleasing to You and salutary for us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut quos salutáribus dignátus es erudíre mystériis; beátæ Francíscæ intercessióne gloriósa, cæléstibus refícias aliméntis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that through the glorious intercession of blessed Frances You would refresh with heavenly food those whom You have deigned to instruct by these saving mysteries; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui de beátæ Maríæ Vírginis útero, Verbum tuum, Angelo nuntiánte, carnem suscípere voluísti; præsta supplícibus tuis: ut qui vere eam Genitrícem Dei crédimus; ejus apud te intercessiónibus adjuvémur: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who willed that Your Word, at the message of an angel, should take flesh in the womb of the blessed Virgin Mary; grant to Your suppliants that we who truly believe her to be the Mother of God may be helped by her intercession with You; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: In méntibus nostris, quǽsumus Dómine, veræ fídei sacraménta confírma: ut qui concéptum de Vírgine, Deum verum et hóminem confitémur; per ejus salutíferæ resurrectiónis poténtiam, ad ætérnam mereámur perveníre lætítiam. Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Strengthen in our minds, we beseech You, O Lord, the mysteries of the true faith; that we who confess Him who was conceived of the Virgin to be true God and true man, may by the power of His saving resurrection deserve to attain eternal joy; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Grátiam tuam, quǽsumus Dómine, méntibus nostris infúnde: ut qui, Angelo nuntiánte, Christi Fílii tui Incarnatiónem cognóvimus; per passiónem ejus et crucem ad resurrectiónis glóriam perducámur: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Pour forth, we beseech You, O Lord, Your grace into our hearts; that we, to whom the Incarnation of Christ Your Son was made known by the message of an angel, may by His passion and cross be brought to the glory of His resurrection; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui géntium multitúdinem, mira beáti Vincéntii Confessóris tui prædicatióne, ad agnitiónem tui nóminis veníre tribuísti: præsta quǽsumus, ut quem ventúrum júdicem nuntiávit in terris; præmiatórem habére mereámur in cælis: Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum Fílium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who by the wonderful preaching of blessed Vincent, Your confessor, brought a multitude of nations to the knowledge of Your name; grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have as our rewarder in heaven Him whom he proclaimed on earth as the Judge to come, our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Múnera, Dómine, nostræ devotiónis offérimus: quæ ut tibi grata sint, et nobis salutária reddántur, beátus Vincéntius Conféssor tuus, qui donis tuis hic éxstitit gloriósus, apud cleméntiam tuam pius pro nobis intercéssor exsístat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion; and that they may be pleasing to You and salutary for us, may blessed Vincent, Your confessor, who was glorious here by Your gifts, stand before Your mercy as our loving intercessor; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Divínis Dómine munéribus satiáti; quǽsumus, ut beáti Vincéntii Confessóris tui méritis gloriósis, salutáris víctimæ desiderátum sentiámus efféctum: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Filled with Your divine gifts, O Lord, we beseech You that through the glorious merits of blessed Vincent, Your confessor, we may feel the desired effect of the saving Victim; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátam Agnétem Vírginem tuam cælésti rore sæpe perfúndere; et oratiónis ejus loca divérsis enátis flóribus decoráre dignátus es: concéde propítius, ut ejus précibus, perpétuo tuæ benedictiónis rore conspérsi; æternitátis fructus percípere mereámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who were pleased often to bedew blessed Agnes, Your virgin, with heavenly dew, and to adorn the places of her prayer with flowers of many kinds springing up; mercifully grant that through her prayers, sprinkled with the unfailing dew of Your blessing, we may deserve to receive the fruits of eternity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Oblátis Dómine placáre munéribus, et sicut beátam Agnétem Vírginem vexíllo sanctæ crucis insigníre dignátus es, ita ejus méritis, holocáusti tui in ara crucis obláti partícipes nos esse concéde. Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Be appeased, O Lord, by the gifts we offer; and as You were pleased to mark blessed Agnes, Your virgin, with the standard of the holy cross, so by her merits grant that we may be partakers of Your holocaust offered on the altar of the cross; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sacratíssimi Córporis et Sánguinis tui, Dómine, sanctificáti libámine: præsta, ut hujus vitæ cursu lætánter expléto; intercedénte beáta Agnéte Vírgine tibi acceptíssima, ætérnis gáudiis pérfrui mereámur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Hallowed by the offering of Your most holy Body and Blood, O Lord, grant that, the course of this life being joyfully finished, we may, through the intercession of blessed Agnes, a virgin most pleasing to You, deserve to enjoy eternal gladness; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui in memóriam passiónis Dómini nostri Jesu Christi, Corónam ejus spíneam venerámur in terris; ab ipso glória et honóre coronári mereámur in cælis: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who on earth venerate the crown of thorns of our Lord Jesus Christ in memory of His passion, may deserve to be crowned by Him with glory and honor in heaven; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Tuórum mílitum Rex omnípotens virtútem corróbora: ut quos in hujus mortalitátis stádio, unigéniti Fílii tui Coróna lætíficat; consummáto cursu certáminis, immortalitátis bravíum apprehéndant. Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Strengthen the might of Your soldiers, O almighty King, that they whom the crown of Your only-begotten Son gladdens in the race of this mortal life may, when the course of the contest is finished, lay hold of the prize of immortality; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Súpplices te rogámus, omnípotens Deus: ut hæc sacraménta, quæ súmpsimus, per sacrosánctæ Fílii tui Corónæ, cujus solémnia recensémus, virtútem; nobis profíciant ad medélam: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We humbly beseech You, almighty God, that these sacraments which we have received may, through the power of the most sacred crown of Your Son, whose feast we keep, avail us for healing; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Petri Mártyris tui fidem cóngrua devotióne sectémur; qui pro ejúsdem fídei dilatatióne, martýrii palmam méruit obtinére: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may follow with fitting devotion the faith of blessed Peter, Your martyr, who for the spreading of that same faith merited to win the palm of martyrdom; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Preces, quas tibi Dómine offérimus, intercedénte beáto Petro Mártyre tuo, cleménter inténde; et púgiles fídei sub tua protectióne custódi. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Mercifully regard, O Lord, the prayers which we offer You through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your martyr; and keep under Your protection the champions of the faith; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Fidéles tuos, Dómine, custódiant sacraménta, quæ súmpsimus; et intercedénte beáto Petro Mártyre tuo, contra omnes advérsos tueántur incúrsus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Let the sacraments we have received safeguard Your faithful, O Lord; and through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your martyr, may they protect them against all hostile assaults; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátæ Catharínæ, virginitátis et patiéntiæ speciáli privilégio decorátæ, malignántium spirítuum certámina víncere, et in amóre tui nóminis inconcússe permanére tribuísti: concéde quǽsumus, ut ejus imitatióne calcáta mundi nequítia, et ómnium hóstium superátis insídiis; ad tuam secúre glóriam transeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who granted to blessed Catherine, adorned with the special privilege of virginity and patience, to overcome the assaults of evil spirits and to remain unshaken in the love of Your name; grant, we beseech You, that by imitating her we may trample on the wickedness of the world, overcome the snares of all our enemies, and pass safely to Your glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Múnera, quǽsumus Dómine, quæ tibi in honórem beátæ Catharínæ Vírginis offérimus, benígno súscipe vultu: et nos ejus méritis ac intercessióne, ad tuam fácito propítius perveníre lætítiam. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Receive with kindly countenance, O Lord, we beseech You, the gifts we offer You in honor of blessed Catherine, Your virgin; and by her merits and intercession graciously bring us to Your joy; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sumptis, Dómine, divínæ grátiæ sacraméntis: quǽsumus, ut intercedénte beáta Catharína Vírgine tibi acceptíssima, hostíles superémus incúrsus; et ad ætérnæ redemptiónis augménta proficiscéntes, tuis semper óculis placeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Having received the sacraments of divine grace, O Lord, we beseech You that, through the intercession of blessed Catherine, a virgin most pleasing to You, we may overcome the assaults of the enemy, and, advancing toward the increase of eternal redemption, may ever be pleasing in Your sight; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui ad conteréndos Ecclésiæ tuæ hostes, et ad divínum cultum reparándum, beátum Pium Pontíficem máximum elígere dignátus es: fac nos ipsíus deféndi præsídiis, et ita tuis inhærére obséquiis; ut ómnium hóstium superátis insídiis, perpétua pace lætémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who for the crushing of the enemies of Your Church and for the restoring of divine worship were pleased to choose blessed Pius as supreme Pontiff; grant that we may be defended by his protection and so cleave to Your service that, overcoming the snares of all our enemies, we may rejoice in everlasting peace; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Súscipe, quǽsumus Dómine, Ecclésiæ tuæ preces et oblatiónes: ut intercedénte beáto Pio Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, in conspéctu tuo in odórem suavitátis ascéndant. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Receive, we beseech You, O Lord, the prayers and offerings of Your Church; that through the intercession of blessed Pius, Your confessor and pontiff, they may rise as an odor of sweetness in Your sight; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Spíritum, Dómine Deus, iustítiæ ac fortitúdinis benígnus infúnde fidélibus tuis; quos beáti Pii Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis zelo ac constántia, ab ómnium hóstium incursióne tuéri dignátus es: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O Lord God, graciously pour forth the spirit of justice and fortitude upon Your faithful, whom You have deigned to protect from the assaults of all their enemies through the zeal and steadfastness of blessed Pius, Your confessor and pontiff; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, pro cujus honóre gloriósus Póntifex Stanisláus gládiis impiórum occúbuit: præsta quǽsumus, ut omnes, qui ejus implórant auxílium; petitiónis suæ salutárem consequántur efféctum: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, for whose honor the glorious bishop Stanislaus fell beneath the swords of wicked men; grant, we beseech You, that all who implore his help may obtain the saving fruit of their petition; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Accépta sit in conspéctu tuo, Dómine, nostra devótio, et beáti Stanislái Mártyris tui atque Pontíficis nobis fiat supplicatióne salutáris, pro cujus solemnitáte defértur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, and may it become salutary for us through the pleading of blessed Stanislaus, Your martyr and bishop, on whose feast it is offered; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: beáti Stanislái Mártyris tui atque Pontíficis, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of blessed Stanislaus, Your martyr and bishop, whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui pópulo tuo ætérnæ salútis beátum Gregórium minístrum tribuísti: præsta quǽsumus, ut quem doctórem vitæ habúimus in terris; intercessórem habére mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who gave to Your people blessed Gregory as a minister of eternal salvation; grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have as an intercessor in heaven him whom we had on earth as a teacher of life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, múnera tuæ majestáti obláta, per intercessiónem beáti Gregórii Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis, ad perpétuam nobis fac proveníre salútem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Almighty and eternal God, through the intercession of blessed Gregory, Your confessor and bishop, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sacraménta salútis nostræ suscipiéntes, concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Gregórii Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis nos ubíque orátio ádjuvet; in cujus veneratióne hæc tuæ obtúlimus majestáti: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may everywhere be helped by the prayer of blessed Gregory, Your confessor and bishop, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui hunc diem beáti Venántii Mártyris tui triúmpho consecrásti; exáudi preces pópuli tui: et præsta, ut qui ejus mérita venerámur; fídei constántiam imitémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who have consecrated this day by the triumph of blessed Venantius, Your martyr; hear the prayers of Your people, and grant that we who venerate his merits may imitate the constancy of his faith; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Hanc oblatiónem, omnípotens Deus, beáti Venántii Mártyris tui mérita tibi reddant accéptam: ut ipsíus subsídiis adjúti, glóriæ ejus consórtes efficiámur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May the merits of blessed Venantius, Your martyr, make this offering acceptable to You, almighty God; that, helped by his aid, we may be made sharers of his glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Súmpsimus, Dómine, ætérnæ vitæ sacraménta, te humíliter deprecántes: ut beáto Venántio Mártyre tuo pro nobis deprecánte; véniam nobis concílient, et grátiam: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We have received, O Lord, the sacraments of eternal life, and humbly beseech You that, blessed Venantius, Your martyr, pleading for us, they may obtain for us pardon and grace; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátum Petrum Cælestínum ad summi Pontificátus ápicem sublimásti; quique illum humilitáti postpónere docuísti: concéde propítius, ut ejus exémplo cuncta mundi despícere; et ad promíssa humílibus prǽmia perveníre felíciter mereámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who raised blessed Peter Celestine to the height of the supreme pontificate, and taught him to set it aside for the sake of humility; mercifully grant that by his example we may despise all things of the world and happily deserve to attain the rewards promised to the humble; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sancti tui, quǽsumus Dómine, nos ubíque lætíficent: ut dum eórum mérita recólimus, patrocínia sentiámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May Your saints, we beseech You, O Lord, everywhere make us glad; that while we recall their merits we may feel their patronage; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut de percéptis munéribus grátias exhibéntes; intercedénte beáto Petro Cælestíno Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, benefícia potióra sumámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that giving thanks for the gifts we have received, we may, through the intercession of blessed Peter Celestine, Your confessor and pontiff, receive still greater benefits; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátum Philíppum Confessórem tuum Sanctórum tuórum glória sublimásti: concéde propítius, ut cujus solemnitáte lætámur; ejus virtútum proficiámus exémplo: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who raised blessed Philip, Your confessor, to the glory of Your saints; mercifully grant that we who rejoice in his feast may profit by the example of his virtues; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sacrifíciis præséntibus, quǽsumus Dómine, inténde placátus: et præsta, ut illo nos igne Spíritus Sanctus inflámmet, quo beáti Philíppi cor mirabíliter penetrávit. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte eiúsdem Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Look graciously, O Lord, we beseech You, upon these present sacrifices, and grant that the Holy Spirit may enkindle us with that fire with which He wondrously pierced the heart of blessed Philip; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the same Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Cæléstibus, Dómine, pasti delíciis: quǽsumus, ut beáti Philíppi Confessóris tui méritis et imitatióne; semper eádem, per quæ veráciter vívimus, appetámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Fed with heavenly delights, O Lord, we beseech You that by the merits and imitation of blessed Philip, Your confessor, we may ever seek after those things by which we truly live; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátum Francíscum novi Ordinis Institutórem orándi stúdio, et pœniténtiæ amóre decorásti: da fámulis tuis in ejus imitatióne ita profícere; ut semper orántes, et corpus in servitútem redigéntes, ad cæléstem glóriam perveníre mereántur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who adorned blessed Francis, founder of a new Order, with zeal for prayer and love of penance; grant to Your servants so to advance in imitating him that, praying always and bringing the body into subjection, they may deserve to attain heavenly glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Francísco Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Francis, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui pópulo tuo ætérnæ salútis beátum Basilíum minístrum tribuísti: præsta quǽsumus, ut quem doctórem vitæ habúimus in terris; intercessórem habére mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who gave to Your people blessed Basil as a minister of eternal salvation; grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have as an intercessor in heaven him whom we had on earth as a teacher of life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sancti Basilíi Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis, quǽsumus Dómine, ánnua solémnitas pietáti tuæ nos reddat accéptos: ut per hæc piæ placatiónis offícia, et illum beáta retribútio comitétur, et nobis grátiæ tuæ dona concíliet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May the yearly feast of Saint Basil, Your confessor and bishop, make us acceptable to Your loving kindness, O Lord, we beseech You; that by these offices of holy propitiation a blessed reward may attend him, and the gifts of Your grace may be won for us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, fidélium remunerátor animárum: præsta, ut beáti Basilíi Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis, cujus venerándam celebrámus festivitátem; précibus indulgéntiam consequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, the rewarder of faithful souls, grant that through the prayers of blessed Basil, Your confessor and bishop, whose venerable feast we celebrate, we may obtain pardon; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Omnípotens et miséricors Deus, majestátem tuam supplíciter exorámus: ut sicut Unigénitum tuum per Visitatiónem et salutatiónem Genitrícis ejus púero clauso in útero revelásti; ita méritis ejúsdem Genitrícis, et précibus, ipsum nos fácias reveláta fácie perpétuo contemplári: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Almighty and merciful God, we humbly entreat Your majesty that, as You revealed Your only-begotten Son to the child enclosed in the womb through the visitation and greeting of His Mother, so by the merits and prayers of the same Mother You would grant us to contemplate Him for ever with unveiled face; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui de ómnibus in te confidéntibus curam semper habes: præsta quǽsumus, ut per oblatiónem, quam tibi offérimus, visitatiónem spirituálem beátæ Maríæ Vírginis in nostris necessitátibus semper sentiámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Almighty and eternal God, who ever have care of all who trust in You; grant, we beseech You, that through the offering which we make to You we may always feel in our needs the spiritual visitation of the blessed Virgin Mary; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui commemoratiónem Visitatiónis beatíssimæ Maríæ Matris Dei fíeri voluísti: præsta quǽsumus, ut per hoc sacrifícium, quod súmpsimus; ab ejus visitatiónis grátia nullátenus excidámus: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Almighty and eternal God, who willed that the commemoration of the Visitation of most blessed Mary, Mother of God, should be kept; grant, we beseech You, that through this sacrifice which we have received we may never fall away from the grace of her visitation; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beatórum Mártyrum tuórum Joánnis et sociórum ejus, gloriósum pro fide tua certámen æternitátis láurea decorásti: concéde propítius, ut eórum méritis et imitatióne certántes in terris; cum ipsis coronári mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who crowned with the laurel of eternity the glorious struggle for Your faith of Your blessed martyrs John and his companions; mercifully grant that, striving on earth by their merits and imitation, we may deserve to be crowned with them in heaven; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Réspice Dómine de sanctuário tuo, et de excélso cælórum habitáculo, sacrifícium, quod immolámus: et sánguine sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum clamánte, corda nostra igne caritátis flamméscant, et ad te preces nostræ in odórem suavitátis ascéndant. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Look down, O Lord, from Your sanctuary and from the lofty dwelling place of heaven upon the sacrifice which we offer; and, the blood of Your holy martyrs crying out, may our hearts glow with the fire of charity, and our prayers rise to You as an odor of sweetness; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, virtútis auctor ac largítor, per sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum fidem et constántiam concéde: ut nos ad sacrum convívium accedéntes, eódem accendámur ardóre; quo ipsi pro veritáte Córporis et Sánguinis tui, vitam tibi in holocáustum obtulére: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, author and giver of strength, grant through the faith and constancy of Your holy martyrs that we who approach the sacred banquet may be kindled with the same ardor with which they offered their lives to You as a holocaust for the truth of Your Body and Blood; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beatórum Pontíficum Ignátii et Domínici ac sociórum sánguine Annamitárum terras rigári voluísti; intercedéntibus tantis Martýribus, fac eas christiána religióne florére. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who willed that the lands of Annam should be watered by the blood of the blessed bishops Ignatius and Dominic and their companions; through the intercession of these great martyrs make them flourish with the Christian religion; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Fortitúdinis auctor ac largítor omnípotens Deus, múnera tuæ majestáti obláta sanctífica: et intercedéntibus beátis Martýribus, quorum hódie solémnia celebrámus, córdium nostrórum medére languóribus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Almighty God, author and giver of fortitude, sanctify the gifts offered to Your majesty; and through the intercession of the blessed martyrs whose feast we celebrate today, heal the weaknesses of our hearts; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Tríbuant nobis, quǽsumus Dómine, tua Sacraménta constántiam; quæ beátos Mártyres aluérunt ad victóriam. Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May Your sacraments, O Lord, we beseech You, give us that constancy with which they nourished the blessed martyrs unto victory; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátum Camíllum, ad animárum in extrémo agóne luctántium subsídium, singulári caritátis prærogatíva decorásti: ejus, quǽsumus, méritis spíritum nobis tuæ dilectiónis infúnde; ut in hora éxitus nostri hostem víncere, et ad cæléstem mereámur corónam perveníre: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who adorned blessed Camillus with a singular gift of charity for the help of souls struggling in their last agony; by his merits, we beseech You, pour into us the spirit of Your love, that in the hour of our death we may overcome the enemy and deserve to attain the heavenly crown; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Camíllo Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Camillus, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Largíre nobis, clementíssime Pater: ut sicut beáta María Magdaléna Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum super ómnia diligéndo, suórum obtínuit véniam peccatórum; ita nobis apud misericórdiam tuam, sempitérnam ímpetret beatitúdinem: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant us, most merciful Father, that as blessed Mary Magdalen, by loving our Lord Jesus Christ above all things, obtained pardon of her sins, so she may obtain for us everlasting happiness from Your mercy; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Hanc nostræ oblatiónis hóstiam, terríbilis et piíssime Deus, beáta María Magdaléna suárum precum cúmulet increméntis, et ad remédium nobis proveníre depóscat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, awesome and most loving, may blessed Mary Magdalen enrich this victim of our offering with the increase of her prayers, and ask that it may avail for our healing; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sanctíficet nos, quǽsumus Dómine, et múniat intercedénte beáta María Magdaléna, divíni múneris sacra libátio; et cæléstium virtútum coherédes effíciat: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May the sacred outpouring of the divine gift, O Lord, we beseech You, sanctify and protect us through the intercession of blessed Mary Magdalen, and make us co-heirs with the heavenly powers; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátam Annam Genitrícis tuæ matrem ad cæléstis vitæ gáudia extulísti: fac nos, quǽsumus, gloriósis ejus méritis ad ætérnam pertíngere beatitúdinem; ex cujus salutári puerpério pro salúte mundi humánam natúram assúmere dignátus es: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who raised blessed Anne, the mother of Your Mother, to the joys of heavenly life; grant, we beseech You, that by her glorious merits we may attain to eternal happiness, You who from her saving offspring deigned to take human nature for the salvation of the world; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Accipe Dómine múnera dignánter obláta: et beátæ Annæ suffragántibus méritis, ad nostræ salútis auxílium proveníre concéde. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Accept, O Lord, the gifts devoutly offered, and grant that through the pleading merits of blessed Anne they may avail for the help of our salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sacraménta salútis nostræ suscipiéntes, concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beátæ Annæ matris beatíssimæ Vírginis Maríæ nos ubíque orátio ádjuvet; in cujus veneratióne hæc tuæ obtúlimus majestáti: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may everywhere be helped by the prayer of blessed Anne, mother of the most blessed Virgin Mary, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui per beátum Alphónsum Maríam Confessórem tuum atque Pontíficem, animárum zelo succénsum, Ecclésiam tuam nova prole fecundásti: quǽsumus, ut ejus salutáribus mónitis edócti, et exémplis roboráti; ad te perveníre felíciter valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who through blessed Alphonsus Mary, Your confessor and bishop, on fire with zeal for souls, enriched Your Church with a new offspring; we beseech You that, taught by his saving counsels and strengthened by his example, we may happily come to You; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Cælésti, Dómine Jesu Christe, sacrifícii igne corda nostra in odórem suavitátis exúre, qui beáto Alphónso Maríæ tribuísti et hæc mystéria celebráre, et per eádem hóstiam tibi sanctam seípsum exhibére. Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O Lord Jesus Christ, burn our hearts with the heavenly fire of the sacrifice unto an odor of sweetness, You who granted blessed Alphonsus Mary both to celebrate these mysteries and through them to offer himself to You as a holy victim; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátum Alphónsum Maríam Confessórem tuum atque Pontíficem, fidélem divíni mystérii dispensatórem et præcónem effecísti: ejus méritis precibúsque concéde, ut fidéles tui et frequénter percípiant; et percipiéndo sine fine colláudent: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who made blessed Alphonsus Mary, Your confessor and bishop, a faithful dispenser and herald of the divine mystery; grant by his merits and prayers that Your faithful may receive it often, and, receiving it, praise You without end; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui Ecclésiam tuam beáti Domínici Confessóris tui, Patris nostri, illumináre dignátus es méritis et doctrínis: concéde, ut ejus intercessióne, temporálibus non destituátur auxíliis; et spirituálibus semper profíciat increméntis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who were pleased to enlighten Your Church by the merits and teaching of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, our Father; grant that through his intercession she may not be deprived of temporal help, and may ever grow in spiritual increase; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Múnera tibi Dómine dicáta sanctífica: ut méritis beáti Domínici Confessóris tui, Patris nostri, nobis profíciant ad medélam. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts dedicated to You; that by the merits of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, our Father, they may avail us for healing; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui peccatórum nostrórum póndere prémimur; beáti Domínici Confessóris tui, Patris nostri, patrocínio sublevémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who are weighed down by the burden of our sins may be raised up by the patronage of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, our Father; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui fídei sacraménta in Unigéniti tui gloriósa Transfiguratióne Patrum testimónio roborásti; et adoptiónem filiórum perféctam, voce delápsa in nube lúcida, mirabíliter præsignásti: concéde propítius, ut ipsíus Regis glóriæ nos coherédes effícias; et ejúsdem glóriæ tríbuas esse consórtes: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who in the glorious Transfiguration of Your only-begotten Son confirmed the mysteries of the faith by the testimony of the fathers, and by the voice that came from the bright cloud wondrously foreshowed the perfect adoption of sons; mercifully grant that You may make us co-heirs of the King of glory Himself, and grant us to be sharers of that same glory; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Obláta, quǽsumus Dómine, múnera, gloriósa Unigéniti tui Transfiguratióne sanctífica: nosque a peccatórum máculis, splendóribus ipsíus illustratiónis emúnda. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Sanctify, we beseech You, O Lord, the gifts offered, through the glorious Transfiguration of Your only-begotten Son, and cleanse us from the stains of sin by the splendor of His brightness; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut sacrosáncta Fílii tui Transfiguratiónis mystéria, quæ solémni celebrámus offício; purificátæ mentis intelligéntia consequámur: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may attain with the understanding of a purified mind the sacred mysteries of the Transfiguration of Your Son, which we celebrate with solemn office; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátum Hyacínthum Confessórem tuum, in divérsis natiónum pópulis, óperum sanctitáte, et miraculórum glória fecísti conspícuum: da nobis, ut ejus in mélius reformémur exémplis; et in advérsis protegámur auxíliis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who made blessed Hyacinth, Your confessor, renowned among the peoples of many nations by the holiness of his works and the glory of his miracles; grant that we may be reformed for the better by his example and protected in adversity by his help; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sacras hóstias, Dómine, intervéntu digníssimæ Matris, intrépidus super aquas ambulátor beátus Hyacínthus ante conspéctum divínæ tuæ majestátis déferat: et ad salútem nostram delátas, benígnus acceptáre dignéris. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Through the intercession of Your most worthy Mother, may blessed Hyacinth, who walked fearless upon the waters, bring these sacred offerings before the sight of Your divine majesty, O Lord; and do You graciously deign to accept them, brought for our salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quos ineffábili suavitáte Córporis et Sánguinis tui, Dómine, recreásti: quǽsumus, ut beáti Hyacínthi piis précibus adjútos; ad ætérnam fácias perveníre lætítiam: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, O Lord, that those whom You have refreshed with the ineffable sweetness of Your Body and Blood, helped by the loving prayers of blessed Hyacinth, You would bring to eternal joy; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Omnípotens et miséricors Deus, qui beátam Joánnam Francíscam tuo amóre succénsam, admirábili spíritus fortitúdine per omnes vitæ sémitas in via perfectiónis donásti; quique per illam illustráre Ecclésiam tuam nova prole voluísti: ejus méritis et précibus concéde, ut qui infirmitátis nostræ cónscii de tua virtúte confídimus; cæléstis grátiæ auxílio cuncta nobis adversántia vincámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Almighty and merciful God, who endowed blessed Jane Frances, on fire with Your love, with wonderful strength of spirit along every path of life in the way of perfection, and willed through her to enrich Your Church with a new offspring; grant by her merits and prayers that we who, conscious of our weakness, trust in Your strength, may by the help of heavenly grace overcome all that is against us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Illo nos amóris igne, quǽsumus Dómine, hæc hóstia salutáris inflámmet, quo beátæ Ioánnæ Francíscæ cor veheménter incéndit, et flammis adússit ætérnæ caritátis. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May this saving victim, we beseech You, O Lord, inflame us with that fire of love with which it vehemently kindled the heart of blessed Jane Frances and seared it with the flames of eternal charity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Spíritum nobis, Dómine, tuæ caritátis infúnde: ut quos cæléstis panis virtúte satiásti; beáta Joánna Francísca intercedénte, fácias terréna despícere, et te solum Deum pura mente sectári: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Pour into us, O Lord, the spirit of Your charity, that, through the intercession of blessed Jane Frances, You would make those whom You have filled with the strength of the heavenly bread despise the things of earth and follow You alone, the true God, with a pure mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui per sanctum Joséphum Confessórem tuum, ad erudiéndam spíritu intelligéntiæ ac pietátis juventútem, novum Ecclésiæ tuæ subsídium providére dignátus es: præsta quǽsumus, nos ejus exémplo et intercessióne ita fácere et docére; ut prǽmia consequámur ætérna: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who through Saint Joseph, Your confessor, were pleased to provide a new help for Your Church in forming the young in the spirit of understanding and piety; grant, we beseech You, that by his example and intercession we may so act and teach as to obtain eternal rewards; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Altáre tuum, Dómine, munéribus cumulámus oblátis: ut ejus nobis fiant supplicatióne propítia, cujus nos donásti patrocínio adjuvári. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We load Your altar, O Lord, with the gifts we offer; that they may become pleasing to You through the pleading of him by whose patronage You have granted us to be helped; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sanctificáti, Dómine, salutári mystério; quǽsumus, ut intercedénte sancto Josépho Confessóre tuo, ad majus semper proficiámus pietátis increméntum: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Hallowed by the saving mystery, O Lord, we beseech You that, through the intercession of Saint Joseph, Your confessor, we may ever advance to a greater increase of piety; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sancti Joánnis Baptístæ Præcursóris et Mártyris tui, quǽsumus Dómine, veneránda festívitas; salutáris auxílii nobis præstet efféctum: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May the venerable feast of Saint John the Baptist, Your precursor and martyr, O Lord, we beseech You, obtain for us the effect of saving help; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Múnera tibi Dómine pro sancti Mártyris tui Joánnis Baptístæ passióne deférimus: quǽsumus, ut ejus obténtu nobis profíciant ad salútem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We offer You gifts, O Lord, for the passion of Your holy martyr John the Baptist; and we beseech You that at his pleading they may avail us unto salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Cónferat nobis, Dómine, sancti Joánnis Baptístæ beáta solémnitas: ut et magnífica sacraménta, quæ súmpsimus, significáta venerémur; et in nobis pótius édita gaudeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May the blessed feast of Saint John the Baptist, O Lord, obtain for us that we may both venerate the great sacraments we have received in what they signify, and rejoice rather in what they bring about in us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Bonórum ómnium largítor omnípotens Deus: qui beátam Rosam cæléstis grátiæ rore prævéntam, virginitátis et patiéntiæ decóre, Indis floréscere voluísti; da nobis fámulis tuis, ut in odórem suavitátis ejus curréntes, Christi bonus odor éffici mereámur: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Almighty God, bestower of all good things, who willed that blessed Rose, prevented by the dew of heavenly grace, should flower among the Indians in the beauty of virginity and patience; grant to us Your servants that, running in the odor of her sweetness, we may deserve to become the good odor of Christ; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Accépta sint tibi, Dómine, laudis hóstiæ, quas humíliter immolámus, beátæ Rosæ Vírginis fragrántia perfúsas: ut illi cónferant ad honórem, et nobis propitiatóriæ reddántur ad salútem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May the sacrifices of praise which we humbly offer You, O Lord, steeped in the fragrance of blessed Rose, Your virgin, be acceptable to You; that they may bring her honor, and become for us a propitiation unto salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Ascéndant ad te Dómine preces nostræ, beátæ Rosæ Vírginis suavitátem redoléntes: ut cæléstibus dápibus temporáliter recreáti; ætérni convívii dulcédine perfruámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May our prayers rise to You, O Lord, fragrant with the sweetness of blessed Rose, Your virgin; that, refreshed in time with the food of heaven, we may enjoy the sweetness of the eternal banquet; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Supplicatiónem servórum tuórum Deus miserátor exáudi: ut qui in Nativitáte Dei Genitrícis et Vírginis congregámur; ejus intercessiónibus a te de instántibus perículis eruámur: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Mercifully hear, O God, the supplication of Your servants, that we who are gathered together on the Nativity of the Virgin Mother of God may by her intercession be delivered by You from the dangers that threaten us; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Unigéniti tui, Dómine, nobis succúrrat humánitas: ut qui natus de Vírgine, Matris integritátem non mínuit, sed sacrávit, in Nativitátis ejus solémniis, nostris nos piáculis éxuens, oblatiónem nostram tibi fáciat accéptam: Jesus Christus Dóminus noster, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May the humanity of Your only-begotten Son, O Lord, come to our aid; that He who, born of the Virgin, did not lessen but hallowed His Mother's integrity, may on the feast of her Nativity free us from our sins and make our offering acceptable to You, Jesus Christ our Lord; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Súmpsimus, Dómine, celebritátis ánnuæ votíva sacraménta; præsta quǽsumus, ut et temporális vitæ nobis remédia prǽbeant, et ætérnæ: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We have received, O Lord, the votive sacraments of this yearly feast; grant, we beseech You, that they may bring us remedies for this temporal life and for the life eternal; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Infirmitátem nostram, quǽsumus Dómine, propítius réspice: et mala ómnia, quæ juste merémur; sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum atque Pontíficum Cornélii et Cypriáni intercessióne avérte: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Mercifully regard our weakness, O Lord, we beseech You, and through the intercession of Your holy martyrs and bishops Cornelius and Cyprian turn away from us all the evils which we justly deserve; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Plebis tuæ, Dómine, múnera benígnus inténde, quæ majestáti tuæ pro sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum atque Pontíficum Cornélii et Cypriáni solemnitátibus sunt dicáta. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Look graciously, O Lord, upon the gifts of Your people, which are dedicated to Your majesty on the feast of Your holy martyrs and bishops Cornelius and Cyprian; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus, Dómine, salutáribus repléti mystériis: ut quorum solémnia celebrámus; eórum oratiónibus adjuvémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Filled with the saving mysteries, we beseech You, O Lord, that we may be helped by the prayers of those whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátum Joánnem Confessórem, grátiæ tuæ ubertáte prævéntum in húmili vitæ génere morum candóre floréscere voluísti: da nobis, quǽsumus, ita ejus vestígia pérsequi; ut ad te puris méntibus perveníre mereámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who willed that blessed John, Your confessor, prevented by the abundance of Your grace, should flourish in a lowly state of life by the purity of his ways; grant us, we beseech You, so to follow in his footsteps that we may deserve to come to You with pure minds; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Laudis tibi Dómine hóstias offérimus in honórem beáti Joánnis Confessóris, qui pro salúte fidélium majestáti tuæ pœniténtiæ víctimam seípsum júgiter immolávit. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise in honor of blessed John, Your confessor, who for the salvation of the faithful continually offered himself to Your majesty as a victim of penance; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Concéde nos, omnípotens Deus, cælésti pane reféctos, beáto Joánne Confessóre intercedénte, júgiter in tuo amóre profícere; cui tribuísti morum candórem, et perféctam caritátem: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
