en: Grant, almighty God, that we who are refreshed with the bread of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed John, Your confessor, ever grow in Your love, You who gave him purity of life and perfect charity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui nos ánnua sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Januárii et sociórum ejus solemnitáte lætíficas: concéde propítius, ut quorum gaudémus méritis; accendámur exémplis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who gladden us by the yearly feast of Your holy martyrs Januarius and his companions; mercifully grant that we who rejoice in their merits may be kindled by their example; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Oblátis, quǽsumus Dómine, placáre munéribus: et intercedéntibus sanctis Martýribus tuis Januário et sóciis ejus, a cunctis nos defénde perículis. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Be appeased, we beseech You, O Lord, by the gifts we offer; and through the intercession of Your holy martyrs Januarius and his companions defend us from all dangers; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Hæc nos commúnio, Dómine, purget a crímine: et intercedéntibus sanctis Martýribus tuis Januário et sóciis ejus; cæléstis remédii fáciat esse consórtes: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May this communion, O Lord, cleanse us from guilt, and through the intercession of Your holy martyrs Januarius and his companions make us sharers in the heavenly remedy; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Da, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Matthǽi Apóstoli tui et Evangelístæ, quam prævenímus, veneránda solémnitas; et devotiónem nobis áugeat, et salútem: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the venerable feast of blessed Matthew, Your apostle and evangelist, which we anticipate, may increase in us both devotion and salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Apostólici reveréntia cúlminis offeréntes tibi sacra mystéria, Dómine quǽsumus, ut beáti Matthǽi Apóstoli tui et Evangelístæ suffrágiis, cujus natalítia prævenímus, plebs tua semper et sua vota deprómat, et desideráta percípiat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Offering You the sacred mysteries in reverence of the apostolic dignity, we beseech You, O Lord, that through the prayers of blessed Matthew, Your apostle and evangelist, whose heavenly birthday we anticipate, Your people may ever both pour forth their prayers and obtain what they desire; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sancti Apóstoli tui et Evangelístæ Matthǽi, quǽsumus Dómine, supplicatióne placátus: et véniam nobis tríbue; et remédia sempitérna concéde: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Appeased, O Lord, we beseech You, by the supplication of Your holy apostle and evangelist Matthew, grant us pardon and bestow on us everlasting remedies; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátum Raymúndum Confessórem tuum insígnem perfectiónis evangélicæ magístrum, et Apostólicæ auctoritátis fidélem adsertórem esse voluísti: concéde propítius, ut ejus exémplo vivéntes in terris; cum ipso coronári mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who willed that blessed Raymond, Your confessor, should be an eminent master of evangelical perfection and a faithful defender of apostolic authority; mercifully grant that we who live on earth after his example may deserve to be crowned with him in heaven; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Per istam oblatiónem et beáti Raymúndi Confessóris tui intercessiónem da, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus, ut terréna despiciéntes cæléstia semper cogitémus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Through this offering and the intercession of blessed Raymond, Your confessor, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that despising earthly things we may ever set our thoughts on the things of heaven; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sumptis, Dómine, Córporis et Sánguinis tui mystériis, humíliter deprecámur: ut, intercedénte fámulo tuo Raymúndo; post hujus vitæ perícula ætérna in cælis gáudia consequámur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Having received the mysteries of Your Body and Blood, O Lord, we humbly entreat You that, through the intercession of Your servant Raymond, we may, after the dangers of this life, attain eternal joys in heaven; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Dómine Deus noster, qui beátæ Birgíttæ per Fílium tuum unigénitum secréta cæléstia revelásti: ipsíus pia intercessióne da nobis fámulis tuis; in revelatióne sempitérnæ glóriæ tuæ gaudére lætántes: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O Lord our God, who through Your only-begotten Son revealed heavenly secrets to blessed Bridget; grant to us Your servants, through her loving intercession, to rejoice with gladness in the revelation of Your everlasting glory; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Accépta tibi sit, Dómine, sacrátæ plebis oblátio pro tuórum honóre Sanctórum, quorum se méritis de tribulatióne percepísse cognóscit auxílium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: ejus, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátum Ludovícum Confessórem tuum, per córporis mortificatiónem, et fídei præcónium Sanctórum glóriæ coæquásti: præsta, ut quod fide profitémur; pietátis opéribus júgiter impleámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who by mortification of the body and the preaching of the faith made blessed Louis, Your confessor, equal to the glory of the saints; grant that what we profess by faith we may ever fulfil by works of piety; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sacrifícium hujus sacræ mensæ, a Rege regum Jesu Christo pro nobis parátæ, tibi Deus offérimus: et beáti Ludovíci suffragántibus méritis, nostrum inde subsídium et solámen hauríre concéde. Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We offer You, O God, the sacrifice of this sacred table, prepared for us by the King of kings, Jesus Christ; and through the pleading merits of blessed Louis grant us to draw from it our help and consolation; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens et miséricors Deus, ut qui beáti Ludovíci mérita celebrámus; ejus étiam virtútes imitémur: et imitándo proficiámus; et proficiéndo ad cæléstia regna cum eo perveníre valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty and merciful God, that we who celebrate the merits of blessed Louis may also imitate his virtues, and by imitating may advance, and by advancing may be able to come with him to the heavenly kingdom; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui nos cónspicis ex nostra infirmitáte defícere; ad amórem tuum nos misericórditer per Sanctórum tuórum exémpla restáura: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who see that we fail through our own weakness; mercifully restore us to Your love by the example of Your saints; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Mýstica nobis Dómine prosit oblátio: quæ nos et a reátibus nostris expédiat, et perpétua salvatióne confírmet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May the mystical offering, O Lord, profit us, that it may both free us from our sins and confirm us in everlasting salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut reátus nostros múnera sacráta puríficent; et recte vivéndi nobis operéntur efféctum: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that the sacred gifts may cleanse our guilt and bring about in us the effect of right living; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Exáudi nos Deus salutáris noster; ut sicut de beátæ Terésiæ Vírginis tuæ festivitáte gaudémus: ita cæléstis ejus doctrínæ pábulo nutriámur; et piæ devotiónis erudiámur afféctu. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Hear us, O God our Savior, that as we rejoice in the feast of blessed Teresa, Your virgin, so we may be nourished by the food of her heavenly teaching and taught by the affection of loving devotion; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Majestáti tuæ, quǽsumus Dómine, beátæ Terésiæ précibus nostra sit accépta devótio: cui medullátum cordis ejus ita plácuit holocáustum: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May our devotion, we beseech You, O Lord, be acceptable to Your majesty through the prayers of blessed Teresa, to whom the inmost holocaust of her heart was so pleasing; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Súbdita tibi família, quam cælésti pane satiásti; quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut beátæ Terésiæ intercessióne et exémplo; misericórdias tuas váleat in ætérnum cantáre: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, O Lord our God, that Your household, subject to You, which You have fed with the bread of heaven, may through the intercession and example of blessed Teresa be able to sing Your mercies for ever; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Intervéniat pro nobis, quǽsumus Dómine, sanctus tuus Lucas Evangelísta; qui crucis mortificatiónem júgiter in suo córpore pro tui nóminis amóre portávit: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May Your holy evangelist Luke intercede for us, we beseech You, O Lord, who for the love of Your name ever bore in his body the mortification of the cross; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Donis cæléstibus da nobis, quǽsumus Dómine, líbera tibi mente servíre: ut múnera quæ deférimus, interveniénte beáto Evangelísta tuo Luca, et medélam nobis operéntur, et glóriam. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, through these heavenly gifts, to serve You with a free mind; that the gifts which we offer may, through the intercession of blessed Luke, Your evangelist, work in us both healing and glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Repléti, Dómine, benedictióne cælésti, supplíciter exorámus: ut quod frágili celebrámus offício; beáti Lucæ Evangelístæ tui nobis prodésse sentiámus auxílio: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Filled, O Lord, with heavenly blessing, we humbly entreat You that what we celebrate with our frail service we may feel to profit us through the help of blessed Luke, Your evangelist; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui nos ómnium Sanctórum tuórum mérita sub una tribuísti celebritáte venerári: quǽsumus, ut desiderátam nobis tuæ propitiatiónis abundántiam; multiplicátis intercessóribus, largiáris: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Almighty and eternal God, who have granted us to venerate in one solemn feast the merits of all Your saints; we beseech You that, with our intercessors multiplied, You would bestow on us the longed-for abundance of Your mercy; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Múnera tibi, Dómine, nostræ devotiónis offérimus: quæ et pro cunctórum tibi grata sint honóre Sanctórum, et nobis salutária, te miseránte, reddántur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion; may they be pleasing to You in honor of all the saints, and by Your mercy become salutary for us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Da, quǽsumus Dómine, fidélibus pópulis, ómnium Sanctórum semper veneratióne lætári; et eórum perpétua supplicatióne muníri: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant to Your faithful people, we beseech You, O Lord, ever to rejoice in the veneration of all the saints, and to be defended by their unceasing supplication; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus humílium celsitúdo, qui beátum Martínum Confessórem tuum ad cæléstia regna transíre fecísti: ejus méritis et intercessióne concéde, nos ejus humilitátem ita imitári in terris; ut cum ipso exaltári mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, the exaltation of the humble, who caused blessed Martin, Your confessor, to pass to the heavenly kingdom; grant by his merits and intercession that we may so imitate his humility on earth as to deserve to be exalted with him in heaven; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Hanc hóstiam, Dómine, quam tibi in honórem beáti Martíni Confessóris sacrándam offérimus, benígnus súscipe: et præsta, ut ejus pia intercessióne, nobis efféctum tuæ salvatiónis impéndat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Graciously receive, O Lord, this victim which we offer to be consecrated to You in honor of blessed Martin, Your confessor; and grant that through his loving intercession it may bring us the effect of Your salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Cæléstibus aliméntis enutríti, súpplices te rogámus, Dómine Deus noster; ut beáto Martíno Confessóre pro nobis intercedénte, tuis semper valeámus obedíre mandátis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Nourished with heavenly food, we humbly beseech You, O Lord our God, that, blessed Martin, Your confessor, interceding for us, we may ever be able to obey Your commandments; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui Ecclésiam tuam beatórum Mártyrum Hierónymi, Valentíni, Francísci, Hyacínthi et Sociórum sánguine fecundáre dignátus es: concéde propítius ut quorum læti recólimus triúmphos; eórum précibus ac méritis adjuvémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who were pleased to make Your Church fruitful by the blood of the blessed martyrs Jerome, Valentine, Francis, Hyacinth and their companions; mercifully grant that we who joyfully recall their triumphs may be helped by their prayers and merits; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sacrifíciis præséntibus, Dómine quǽsumus, inténde placátus: ut intercedéntibus beátis Martýribus tuis devotióni nostræ profíciant et salúti. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Look graciously, O Lord, we beseech You, upon these present sacrifices; that through the intercession of Your blessed martyrs they may profit our devotion and our salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut beatórum Mártyrum tuórum Hierónymi, Valentíni, Francísci, Hyacínthi atque Sociórum cæléstibus mystériis celebráta solémnitas; indulgéntiam nobis tuæ propitiatiónis acquírat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that the feast of Your blessed martyrs Jerome, Valentine, Francis, Hyacinth and their companions, celebrated with heavenly mysteries, may obtain for us the pardon of Your mercy; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Tuórum corda fidélium Deus miserátor illústra: et beátæ Elísabeth précibus gloriósis, fac nos próspera mundi despícere; et cælésti semper consolatióne gaudére: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Enlighten, O God of mercy, the hearts of Your faithful; and through the glorious prayers of blessed Elizabeth make us despise the prosperity of this world and ever rejoice in heavenly consolation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Múnera, Dómine, nostræ devotiónis offérimus: ut tibi grata, et nobis salutária, beátæ Elísabeth pia supplicatióne reddántur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that through the loving pleading of blessed Elizabeth they may become pleasing to You and salutary for us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut quos salutáribus dignátus es erudíre mystériis; beátæ Elísabeth intercessióne gloriósa, cæléstibus refícias aliméntis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that through the glorious intercession of blessed Elizabeth You would refresh with heavenly food those whom You have deigned to instruct by these saving mysteries; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, Spíritus Sancti habitáculum hodiérna die in templo præsentári voluísti; præsta quǽsumus, ut ejus intercessióne in templo glóriæ tuæ præsentári mereámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte eiúsdem Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, You were pleased that the blessed Mary ever-virgin, herself the dwelling place <?ftjie Holy Spirit, should on this day be presented in the "temple; grant, we beseech You, that through her prayers, we may be worthy to be presented in the temple of Your glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the same Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Unigéniti tui, Dómine, nobis succúrrat humánitas: ut qui natus de Vírgine, Matris integritátem non mínuit, sed sacrávit, in solemnitáte ejus, nostris nos piáculis éxuens, oblatiónem nostram tibi fáciat accéptam: Jesus Christus Dóminus noster, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Súmpsimus, Dómine, celebritátis ánnuæ votíva sacraménta; præsta quǽsumus, ut et temporális vitæ nobis remédia prǽbeant, et ætérnæ: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We have received, 0, Lord, the votive sacraments of our yearly feast; grant, we beseech You, that these may be to us a remedy both in this life and toward life eternal; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui nos ánnua beáti Cleméntis Mártyris tui atque Pontíficis solemnitáte lætíficas: concéde propítius, ut cujus natalítia cólimus; virtútem quoque passiónis imitémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who year by year gladden us by the solemnity of Your holy martyr and bishop, Clement; mercifully grant that we may imitate his fortitude under suffering, whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Múnera tibi Dómine obláta sanctífica: et intercedénte beáto Cleménte Mártyre tuo atque Pontífice, per hæc nos a peccatórum nostrórum máculis emúnda. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts consecrated to You; and for their sake, at the intercession of blessed Clement, Your martyr and bishop, cleanse us from the stains of our sins; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Córporis sacri, et pretiósi Sánguinis repléti libámine, quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut quod pia devotióne gérimus; intercedénte beáto Cleménte Mártyre tuo atque Pontífice, certa redemptióne capiámus: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Filled with the participation of Your sacred body and precious blood, we pray You, O Lord our God, that what we carry out with devoted love, we may receive as an assurance of our redemption; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui Indiárum gentes beáti Francísci prædicatióne et miráculis Ecclésiæ tuæ aggregáre voluísti: concéde propítius, ut cujus gloriósa mérita venerámur; virtútum quoque imitémur exémpla: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, You were pleased to add to Your Church the people of the Indies through the preaching and miracles of blessed Francis; mercifully grant that even as we venerate his glorious merits we may imitate the example of his virtues; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we pray You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may, for the honor of Ypur saints, be pleasing to You, and cleanse us in body and soul; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Francísco Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received this heavenly food m;:i.y,through the pleading of blessed Vincent, Your. cdnfessor, be shielded from all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátam Stéphanam Vírginem tuam, Crucifíxi amóre succénsam, ejúsdem passiónis consórtem mirabíliter effecísti: præsta quǽsumus, ut ejus intercessióne et exémplo; imágini Fílii tui confórmes fíeri mereámur: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Accépta tibi sit, Dómine, sacrátæ plebis oblátio pro tuórum honóre Sanctórum, quorum se méritis de tribulatióne percepísse cognóscit auxílium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May this offering of Your people be accepted by You, O Lord, for the honor of those Your saints through whose merits they are sensible of having received help in their tribulations; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: ejus, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: You have satisfied Your family, O Lord, with Your gifts; ever re-inflame our zeal by the intercession of him whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beáti Gundisálvi Confessóris tui mentem sancti nóminis tui amóre mirabíliter inflammásti: concéde quǽsumus, ut illíus vestígiis inhæréntes, semper te cogitémus; et quæ tibi grata sunt, inflammáto stúdio faciámus: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, You wonderfully set on fire with the love of Your holy name the soul of Your blessed confessor Gonsalvo; grant us, we beseech You, to tread in; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Laudis tibi Dómine hóstias immolámus in tuórum commemoratióne Sanctórum: quibus nos et præséntibus éxui malis confídimus, et futúris. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We offer You, O Lord, victims of praise in memory of Your saints; and trust thereby to be freed from all ills both present and to come; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Refécti cibo potúque cælésti, Deus noster, te súpplices exorámus: ut in cujus hæc commemoratióne percépimus; ejus muniámur et précibus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Refreshed with tlli.s heavenly food and drink, our God, we humbly pray, that he in whose memory we have received this sacrament, may help us by his prayers; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Dómine Jesu Christe, qui beátum Andréam Confessórem tuum apostólico spíritu decorásti: fac nos, ejus imitatióne, ita verbo et exémplo profícere; ut úberem fructum inde reférre valeámus: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O Lord Jesus Christ, who adorned blessed Andrew, Your confessor, with apostolic spirit; grant us so to advance by his words and example, as to reap therefrom abundant fruit: who live and. reign. Who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we pray You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may, for the honor of Ypur saints, be pleasing to You, and cleanse us in body and soul; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Andréa Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received this heavenly food m;:i.y,through the pleading of blessed Vincent, Your. cdnfessor, be shielded from all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, cui humílium et mansuetórum semper plácuit deprecátio: fac nos beáti Marcolíni précibus et exémplis ita profícere; ut vere mites et húmiles corde effécti, facílius tua dona capiámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, to whom the prayer of the humble and meek is always pleasing; grant that we may so profit by the intercession and example of blessed Marcolinus, that becoming ruly meek and humble of heart, we may the more readily receive Your gifts; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we pray You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may, for the honor of Ypur saints, be pleasing to You, and cleanse us in body and soul; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Marcolíno Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received this heavenly food m;:i.y,through the pleading of blessed Vincent, Your. cdnfessor, be shielded from all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátam Maríam, tuæ grátiæ ubertáte prævéntam, contemplatiónis dono, et exímia in próximum caritáte mirábilem effecísti: ex ejus nobis imitatióne concéde; ut cæléstia meditántes, et áliis misericórdiam exhibéntes, ætérnam glóriam cum ipsa cónsequi mereámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Miserátio tua Deus, interveniénte beáta María, ómnium peccatórum máculas in nobis cleménter abstérgat: ut purificáti mente et córpore, hóstiam sanctam tibi digne offerámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May Your mercy, O God, at the prayer of blessed Mary, graciously cleanse away in us the stains of sin; so that purified in mind and body, we may worthily offer to You this sacred victim: through, etc. MEMORY OF ST. MARTINA; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Refécti cibo cælésti, ac amóris sacraménto recreáti, súpplices te Dómine deprecámur: ut per mérita beátæ Maríæ corda nostra a terrénis desidériis expédias; et tuæ caritátis igne succéndas: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Fed with the food of heaven and refreshed with the sacrament of love, we humbly beseech You, O Lord, by the merits of blessed Mary, to free.our hearts from all earthly desires and.enkindle them with the fire of Your love; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Spíritum nobis beáti Nicolái Confessóris tui, Deus, benígnus infúnde: ut sicut illum in prædicatióne verbi tui, ac in procuránda proximórum salúte, singulári grátia decorásti; ipsíus précibus fácias nos in eádem vocatióne sancta fírmiter permanére: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Sanctífica, quǽsumus Dómine, munus oblátum: et beáti Nicolái méritis et exémplis digna hóstia misericórditer effécti, simus semper in corde férvidi, et in ópere efficáces. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Hallow this offered gift, we pray You, O Lord, that through the merits and exai:nple of the blessed Nicholas, we may mercifully become a fitting sacrifice and be forever fervent in soul and fruitful in deed; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Hæc nos commúnio, Dómine, sacri múneris partícipes effíciat: et beáti Nicolái Confessóris tui vestígiis júgiter insisténtes; mereámur páriter cum ipso in cælis coronári: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui beátum Alvarum Confessórem tuum caritátis et pœniténtiæ donis insígniter decorásti: da ut ejus intercessióne et exémplo, semper Christi mortificatiónem in córpore; et tui amórem in corde gerámus: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who signally endowed blessed Alvarez, Your confessor, with the gifts of penance and divine love; grant that we, -by his intercession and example, may ever bear the mortification of Christ in our bodies, and Your love in our hearts: through the same Lord; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we pray You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may, for the honor of Ypur saints, be pleasing to You, and cleanse us in body and soul; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Alvaro Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received this heavenly food may, through the pleading of blessed Peter, Your confessor, be shielded from all ills; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátum Christóphorum Confessórem dignum tibi fámulum reddidísti: ejus méritis et imitatióne concéde; ut Christum in nobis tota mentis intentióne, et cordis afféctu portáre valeámus: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who made blessed Christopher, Your confessor, Your worthy serva.:qt;grant that throughJiis merits and example, we may bear Christ within us by the whole thought of our mind and love of our 'heart; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Hæc hóstia, quǽsumus Dómine, quam tibi in honórem beáti Christóphori Confessóris offérimus, in nostræ provéniat salútis auxílium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May this victim, we pray-You, O Lord, which we offer to You in honor of Your blessed confessor, Christopher, be a help to our salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Salutári cibo refécti, te Dómine deprecámur: ut beáto Christóphoro pro nobis intercedénte; ad cæléste convívium nos perdúcere dignéris: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Refreshed by this life-giving food, we pray You, O Lord, that through the intercession of the blessed Christopher on our behalf, You would be pleased to lead us to the heavenly banquet; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Omnípotens, ætérne Deus, qui sapiéntiæ tuæ luce, ténebras ignorántiæ repéllis: auge méritis et précibus beáti Isnárdi Confessóris tui, virtútem fídei; ut ignis, quem grátia tua fecit accéndi, nullis tentatiónibus exstinguátur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Sacrándum Tibi Dómine munus offérimus, quo beáti Isnárdi fidélis servi tui mérita recoléntes: purificatiónem quoque nostris méntibus implorámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We offer You, O Lord, our gift to be consecrated, whereby we call to mind the merits,of Your faithful servant blessed Isnard and implore the purification of our minds; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut reátum nostrum múnera sancta puríficent; et intercedénte beáto Isnárdo, Confessóre tuo, recte vivéndi nobis operéntur efféctum: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We ask of You, almighty God, that these sacred gifts may purify our guilt, and by the intercession of blessed Isnard, Your confessor, be to us an effectual means to righteousness of life: thr011gh our Lord. '; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátæ Sibyllínæ Vírginis, corporálibus lumínibus orbátæ, mentem admirábili claritátis fulgóre illustráre voluísti: ejus intercessióne nobis concéde, ut supérna luce illumináti terréna despiciámus; et ætérna efficáciter exquirámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Súscipe Dómine oblatiónem, quam tibi offérimus, et interveniénte beáta Sibyllína, præsta, ut sicut ipsa passiónis Fílii tui mystéria in terris devóte est veneráta, ita nos eórum fructum cónsequi mereámur. Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Receive, O Lord, the offering we make to You; and at the prayers of the blessed Sibyl grant, that as she devoutly honored on earth the mysteries of Your Son's passion, so we may be worthy to reap their fruit in heaven; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Percépta, Dómine, tui Córporis et Sánguinis mystéria; per intercessiónem beátæ Sibyllínæ nos reddant in virtútum opéribus efficáces, et in tuo amóre fervéntes: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui ad unitátem fídei promovéndam, beáto António Mártyri tuo invíctam ánimi fortitúdinem contulísti: da nobis, quǽsumus, ita ejus vestígia sectári; ut finem fídei nostræ, salútem animárum reportémus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, to promote the unity of the faith You bestowed on blessed Anthony, Your martyr, a dauntless strength of soul; grant to us, we pray, so to follow his footsteps that we may attain the object of our faith, even the salvation of our souls; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sacrifícium, Dómine, quod tibi in honórem beáti Antónii Mártyris offérimus, benígnus admítte: ut Ecclésiam tuam ab omni éruas hæreticórum nequítia, et in tuæ protectiónis securitáte constítuas. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Graciously accept, O Lord, the sacrifice we. offer You in honor of the blessed martyr Anthony;that You may rescue Your Church from all the wickedness of heretics and set it within Your safe keeping; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Dómine Jesu, qui beátum Antónium cælésti hac mensa ad martýrii certámen roborásti: ejus intercessióne da nobis in ejúsdem cibi fortitúdine omnes salútis hostes superáre; et ad ætérna gáudia felíciter perveníre: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O Lord Jesus, who at this heavenly table strengthened blessed Anthony for the fight of martyrdom; grant to us at his prayers, that in the strength of this same food, we may overthrow the enemies of our salvation, and happily come to the joys of eternity; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátam Margarítam Vírginem lumínibus orbam nasci voluísti; ut intus illumináto cordis óculo, te solum assídue contemplarétur: esto lumen oculórum nostrórum, quo mundi hujus ténebris carére valeámus; et perveniámus ad pátriam claritátis ætérnæ: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Accépta tibi sit, Dómine, sacrátæ plebis oblátio pro tuórum honóre Sanctórum, quorum se méritis de tribulatióne percepísse cognóscit auxílium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May this offering of Your people be accepted by You, O Lord, for the honor of those Your saints through whose merits they are sensible of having received help in their tribulations; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: ejus, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: You have satisfied Your family, O Lord, with Your gifts; ever re-inflame our zeal by the intercession of him whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui in maris perículis constitútis beáti Petri opem singulárem osténdis: ejus nobis intercessióne concéde, ut in hujus vitæ procéllis tuæ grátiæ lumen semper affúlgeat; quo ætérnæ salútis portum inveníre valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who bestowed the singular help of blessed Peter on those in peril of the sea; grant at his prayers that in all the storms of this life the light of Your grace may shine forth, and enable us to find the  harbor of everlasting salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Propitiáre nobis Deus noster: ut quos salutáribus réficis sacraméntis, intercessióne beáti Petri Confessóris tui, jungas agmínibus Beatórum. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Look down in mercy upon us, O God, our God; that at the prayers of the blessed Peter, Your confessor, Yo{! ayjoin to the ranks of the blessed, those whom You refresh with Your sacraments: thrO"qgbour Lord.  MEMORY OF MARTYRS; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Corda nostra, quǽsumus Dómine, lúmine tuæ claritátis illústra: ut verbo salútis erudíti, interveniénte beáto Petro Confessóre tuo, nóxia cuncta vitémus; et quæ recta sunt, ágere valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Enlighten our hearts, we,beseech You, O Lord, with the brightness of Your shining; that being taught;hy tbelife-giving word, we may, tq.rough the interce&.siQti,of the: blessed Peter, Your co11:fessor, is avoid all that harmful,.--.ad.de;>aj.lthat is p.ghteous; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Tríbue nobis, miséricors Deus, spíritum oratiónis et pœniténtiæ: ut beátæ Claræ vestígiis inhæréntes; mereámur, quam ipsa in cælis accépit, corónam obtinére: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Bestow on us, O merciful God; the spirit of prayer and penance, that following in the footsteps of blessed Clare we may be. worthy to win the crown she bas received in heaven; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui per unigénitum Fílium tuum in ara crucis mundum redímere voluísti: concéde, ut dum ipsum immolámus, per mérita beátæ Claræ ætérnæ salvatiónis nostræ fidúcia roborémur. Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who through the sacrifice. of Your Only-begotten Son upon the altar of the cross willed to redeem the world; grant that while we offer Him as a victim, we may be strengthened in the hope of our eternal salvation, by the merits of the blessed Clare; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui dignátus es hujus spirituális convívii partícipes nos fíeri: per intercessiónem beátæ Claræ da nobis ita vívere; ut ad ætérnum perveníre valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who e pleased to make us partakers of t4is spiritual banquet, grant to us.,..at the intercession of the blessed Clare, so to live that we may attain to Your eternal banquet; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátum Bartholomǽum insígnem fídei propugnatórem effecísti; et martýrii coróna sublimásti: da nobis ejus méritis et intercessióne crucem júgiter ferre; ut cum ipso glóriæ tuæ mereámur esse partícipes: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who made blessed Bartholomew a glorious champion of the faith and ennobled him with the crown of martyrdom; by his merits and prayers may we always bear Your cross, that together with:pim we may be worthy to share Your glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Oblatiónem nostram, clementíssime Jesu, beáti Bartholomǽi intercéssio sancta comméndet: qui fide et caritáte suffúltus, ánimam suam propter te et Evangélium non tímuit pérdere, ut vitam ætérnam inveníret. Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May our offering be pleasing to You, O Jesus most kind, by the holy prayers of blessed Bartholomew who, sustained by faith and charity, did not fear to lose his life for You and the gospel, that he might find life everlasting; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Puríficet nos, quǽsumus Dómine, divíni sacraménti munus oblátum: et intercedénte beáto Bartholomǽo Mártyre: in tuæ veritátis luce confírmet: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, cujus misericórdiæ non est númerus: te humíliter deprecámur; ut intercedéntibus beátis Domínico et Gregório Confessóribus tuis, a peccatórum nostrórum póndere subdúcti, glóriam ab ipsis obténtam assequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, whose mercies are without number we humbly beseech You, through the prayers of blessed Dominic and Gregory, Your confessors, that being loosed from the burden of our sins we too may reach the glory they have attained; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Oblatiónem, Dómine, quam tibi offérimus, propítius réspice, et méritis beatórum Domínici et Gregórii præsta, ut nosmetípsos tibi hóstiam acceptábilem exhibeámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Graciously look down upon the offering which we make to You, O Lord, and through the merits of blessed Dominic and Gregory, grant that we may present ourselves an acceptable sacrifice in Your sight; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut sacra mystéria, quæ súmpsimus; per intercessiónem beatórum Domínici et Gregórii sint nobis secúrum contra ómnia mala futúra præsídium: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, O Lord our God, that the sacred mysteries we have received may; through the pleading of blessed Dominic and Gregory, be to us a sure defense against all future ills; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui inter regáles delícias, et mundi illécebras beátam Joánnam Vírginem tuam virtúte constántiæ roborásti: quǽsumus, ut ejus intercessióne fidéles tui terréna despíciant; et ad cæléstia semper aspírent: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who by. the virtue of steadfastness strengthened Saint Casimir amidst royal delights and worldly allurements; bestow on Your faithful, we beseech You, to scorn the things of earth, and ever to seek after the things of heaven; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Accépta tibi sit, Dómine, sacrátæ plebis oblátio pro tuórum honóre Sanctórum, quorum se méritis de tribulatióne percepísse cognóscit auxílium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May this offering of Your people be accepted by You, O Lord, for the honor of those Your saints through whose merits they are sensible of having received help in their tribulations; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: ejus, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: You have satisfied Your family, O Lord, with Your gifts; ever re-inflame our zeal by the intercession of him whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Misericórdiam tuam, Deus, súpplices implorámus: ut sicut ea præveniénte beátum Ægídium in viam iustítiæ et sanctitátis redíre fecísti; ita nos e servitúte ac morte peccáti, in perféctam tránsferas libertátem et vitam: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, we humbly crave Your mercy, that as by its guidance You led back blessed Giles to tjghteous and holy ways, so You would lead us back from the thraldom and death of sin to the fullness of freedom and life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we pray You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may, for the honor of Ypur saints, be pleasing to You, and cleanse us in body and soul; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Ægídio Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received this heavenly food m;:i.y,through the pleading of blessed Vincent, Your. cdnfessor, be shielded from all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beáto Andréæ Confessóri tuo Evangélium pacis ópere ac sermóne prædicáre tribuísti: ejus quǽsumus intercessióne, fac nos legem tuam corde perfécto suscípere; et sanctis móribus adimplére. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who empowered blessed Andrew, Y"our confessor, to preach by life and word the gospel of peace; grant, we beseech Y"ou, through his intercession, that we may welcome Your law into a perfect heart and fulfill it by a holy life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Concéde sanctíssime Pater, ut immaculátam Hóstiam tibi digne libémus; quam beátus Andréas puris mánibus immolábat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, O most holy Father, that we may worthily offer to You this unspotted victim which the blessed Andrew sacrificed with unsullied hands; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Córporis et Sánguinis tui Sacraméntum, quǽsumus Dómine, ab omni nos labe puríficet: et intercedénte beáto Andréa Confessóre tuo; sanctitátem júgiter in nobis operétur. Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui beátam Colúmbam Vírginem tuam, puritáte et innocéntia cándidam, supérnis fulgóribus illustráre dignátus es: concéde quǽsumus, ut ejus intercessióne, puris tibi méntibus serviéntes in terris; splendóre glóriæ tuæ pérfrui mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Accépta tibi sit, Dómine, sacrátæ plebis oblátio pro tuórum honóre Sanctórum, quorum se méritis de tribulatióne percepísse cognóscit auxílium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May this offering of Your people be accepted by You, O Lord, for the honor of those Your saints through whose merits they are sensible of having received help in their tribulations; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: ejus, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: You have satisfied Your family, O Lord, with Your gifts; ever re-inflame our zeal by the intercession of him whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Amátor animárum Deus, qui in beáta María Bartholomǽa Vírgine tua, miram ægritúdinum tolerántiam pari cum innocéntia sociásti: concéde, ut qui ex mérito nostræ actiónis afflígimur; tuæ grátiæ consolatióne respirémus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, lover of souls, who in blessed Mary Bartholomew, Your virgin, linked a wondrous steadfastness in suffering with equal innocence; grant that we who suffer as a result of our sins, may be refreshed by the consolations of Your grace; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Panem Angelórum, et vinum gérminans vírgines, offeréntes tibi Dómine, beáta María Bartholomǽa Vírgine intercedénte, a sórdibus líbera: ut inter puras Angelórum ácies perpétuo collocári mereámur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Effúnde super nos, Dómine Jesu, grátiam tuæ miseratiónis: et præsta, ut intercedénte beáta María Bartholomǽa Vírgine tua, ab ómnibus adversitátibus liberémur; et in tuo servítio perseverántes, ad ætérnam perveníre lætítiam valeámus: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus qui beátum Andréam Confessórem atque Pontíficem in prædicatióne verbi tui et in múnere boni pastóris pietáte ac doctrína excéllere voluísti: ejus intercessióne nobis concéde, ut animóse in tuo sancto servítio certántes; copiósum fructum inde reférre mereámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Per hanc immaculátam hóstiam súpplices te deprecámur, Dómine, ut intercedénte beáto Andréa, nosmetípsos hóstiam tibi placéntem offérre valeámus. Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: By this unblemished offering, we implore You at Your feet, O Lord, that by the intercession of blessed Andrew, we may offer ourselves victims acceptable to Your sight; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Pretiósi Córporis et Sánguinis tui suscéptio, Dómine, tantam nobis virtútem adjíciat; ut beáti Andréæ suffrágiis et exémplis, tuæ divínæ voluntáti nos semper congruéntes efficiámur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui nos beáti Jacóbi Confessóris tui ánnua solemnitáte lætíficas: concéde propítius, ut cujus natalítia cólimus; étiam actiónes imitémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who year by year gladden us by the solemnity of blessed James, Your confessor, mercifully grant that as we celebrate his feast, we may follow in his ways; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Laudis tibi Dómine hóstias immolámus in tuórum commemoratióne Sanctórum: quibus nos et præséntibus éxui malis confídimus, et futúris. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We sacrifice to You, O Lord, victims of praise in memory of Your saints, and trust thereby to be freed from all ills both present and to come; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Refécti cibo potúque cælésti, Deus noster, te súpplices exorámus: ut in cujus hæc commemoratióne percépimus; ejus muniámur et précibus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Refreshed with tlli.s heavenly food and drink, our God, we humbly pray, that he in whose memory we have received this sacrament, may help us by his prayers; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui ad errántes fidéles in viam salútis revocándos, beátum Stéphanum Confessórem tuum evangélicæ prædicatiónis exímium minístrum effecísti: ejus méritis et intercessióne concéde; ut a peccátis ómnibus expedíti, sémitam mandatórum tuórum semper currámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Accipe clementíssime Deus múnera tibi reverénter obláta, et qui per beátum Stéphanum Confessórem tuum multos errántes in viam iustítiæ et sanctitátis redíre fecísti, nostras étiam rebélles ad te propítius convérte voluntátes. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Receive, O most merciful God, the gifts reverently offered to You; and as You led many wanderers back into the way of justice and holiness. through blessed Stephen, Your confessor, so graciously tum our rebel wills to You; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Ineffabílibus recreáti sacraméntis, quǽsumus cleméntiam tuam omnípotens Deus: ut qui beáti Stéphani Confessóris tui præclára mérita celebrámus; ejus intercessióne, ætérna gáudia, his mystériis promíssa, consequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui beátæ Ioánnæ Vírginis tuæ puritátem exímiam, et férvidam caritátem donis cæléstibus cumulásti: fac nos ita ejus æmulári virtútes; ut castitáte vitæ, ac puris semper tibi placeámus afféctibus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who showered with heavenly gifts the eminent purity and burning love of Your blessed virgin, Jane; grant to us, so to imitate her virtues that we may be ever pleasing to You by our unsullied life and stainless love; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Accépta tibi sit, Dómine, sacrátæ plebis oblátio pro tuórum honóre Sanctórum, quorum se méritis de tribulatióne percepísse cognóscit auxílium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May this offering of Your people be accepted by You, O Lord, for the honor of those Your saints through whose merits they are sensible of having received help in their tribulations; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: ejus, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: You have satisfied Your family, O Lord, with Your gifts; ever re-inflame our zeal by the intercession of him whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Da nobis, quǽsumus Dómine Jesu, beáti Augustíni Confessóris tui méritis et imitatióne, ita carnis desidéria per pœniténtiam exstínguere; ut in tua semper grátia et cognitióne crescámus: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Bestow on us, O Lord Jesus, we pray, by the merits and example of the blessed Augustine, Your confessor, so to extinguish the sinful desires of the flesh, that we may ever grow in Your grace and truth; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Fac nos omnípotens Deus, immaculátam hóstiam eo tibi accénsæ devotiónis afféctu sacráre, quo beátus Conféssor tuus Augustínus in ea immolánda flagrábat: ut digne majestáti tuæ serviéntes, optáta indulgéntiæ tuæ múnera consequámur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Angelórum pane reféctos, clementíssime Deus, éxcitent nos júgiter beáti Augustíni Confessóris tui salutária exémpla, et pia intercéssio: ut infinítam bonitátem tuam usque ad mortem laudáre; ac perfécta tandem caritáte, perenníque cántico in cælis prósequi valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui beátum Antónium Confessórem tuum divíno amóre inflammásti: accénde quǽsumus, eo intercedénte, in córdibus nostris ignem tuæ caritátis; ut te diligéntes in terris, gáudiis ætérnis perfruámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who set on fire with divine love blessed Anthony, Your confessor; at his intercession, we beseech You, enkindle within our hearts the fire of Your love, that loving You on earth we may enjoy unending bliss in heaven; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Per hæc sacra dona, quæ offérimus, tuére Dómine fámulos tuos: et quos beáti Antónii glória lætíficat, fac tibi mente et córpore devótos. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Córporis et Sánguinis tui mystério refécti, quǽsumus Dómine: ut cum beáto António connumerémur in pátria; cujus exémplis ad te pertráhimur in via: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Refreshed by the mystery of Your body and blood, we pray You, O Lord, that we may be counted in our fatherland with blessed Anthony whose example draws us to You while we are yet on the way; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui Ecclésiæ tuæ in beáto Augustíno Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice boni pastóris exémplum providére dignátus es: concéde propítius; ut ejus intercessióne, in loco páscuæ tuæ perpétuo collocári mereámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who were pleased to provide for Your Church in blessed Augustine, Your confessor and bishop, an example of the good shepherd; mercifully grant that by his intercession we may be found worthy to be set in Your place of -pasture forever; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Accépta sit in conspéctu tuo Dómine nostra devótio: ut ejus nobis fiat supplicatióne salutáris, pro cujus solemnitáte defértur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May our devotion be so acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, that at the pleading of him on whose feast day it is offered, it may be an aid to us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Da, quǽsumus Dómine, fidélibus tuis, Sanctórum tuórum semper veneratióne lætári; et eórum perpétua supplicatióne muníri: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant to Your faithful, we beseech You, O Lord, ever to be gladdened by the veneration of Your saints, and to be fortified by their interceding prayer: through out Lord. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui in fídei increméntum, beátum Joánnem Confessórem verbi tui præcónem exímium effecísti: ejus nobis intercessióne largíre, ut quod corde crédimus ad justítiam; ore ad salútem confiteámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who for the spread of the faith made blessed John, Your confessor, a noble preacher of Your word; grant to us through his intercession, that what we believe with the heart unto justice, we may confess with the mouth unto salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we pray You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may, for the honor of Your Saints, be pleasing to You and may likewise cleanse us in body and soul; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Joánne Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received this heavenly food m;:i.y,through the pleading of blessed Vincent, Your. cdnfessor, be shielded from all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Omnípotens et miséricors Deus, cui servíre regnáre est: per mérita et intercessiónem beáti Aimónis Confessóris tui, quem exímium fídei propugnatórem effecísti, concéde; ut mandátis tuis fidéliter serviéntes in terris, ætérno regno pérfrui cum ipso mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Oblátis Dómine placáre munéribus, et intercedénte beáto Aimóne Confessóre tuo, omnipoténtem déxteram ad defensiónem Ecclésiæ tuæ cleménter exténde: ut destrúctis adversitátibus et erróribus univérsis, optáta fídei unitáte, et pace lætétur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Dómine Jesu pastor bone, qui ad unitátem Ecclésiæ tuæ promovéndam, omnes oves tuas uníus cæléstis convívii partícipes esse voluísti: præsta quǽsumus; ut beáti Aimónis Confessóris tui interveniéntibus méritis, una sit semper in grege tuo fides méntium, et píetas actiónum: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui prodigiósa tui Sánguinis aspersióne dignátus es beátum Jacóbum Confessórem secúra ætérnæ salútis fidúcia roboráre: diláta super nos eádem víscera misericórdiæ tuæ; ut redemptiónis nostræ imbúti signáculo, inter oves déxteræ tuæ perpétuo computémur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Laudis tibi Dómine hóstias immolámus in tuórum commemoratióne Sanctórum: quibus nos et præséntibus éxui malis confídimus, et futúris. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We immolate victims of praise to You, O Lord, in memory of Your saints; and trust thereby to be freed from all ills both present and to come; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Refécti cibo potúque cælésti, Deus noster, te súpplices exorámus: ut in cujus hæc commemoratióne percépimus; ejus muniámur et précibus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Refreshed with tlli.s heavenly food and drink, our God, we humbly pray, that he in whose memory we have received this sacrament, may help us by his prayers; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
