la: Spes nostra Dómine, qui beátæ Catharínæ cor teípso plenum, cæléstium donórum abundántia decorásti: tantæ Vírginis intercessióne concéde, ut totus nobis figátur in corde; qui totus pro nobis fixus fuit in cruce: Dóminus noster Jesus Christus Fílius tuus; qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Non ignári, Dómine, vitiórum nostrórum, audémus ad treméndam Agni tui mensam accédere, Catharínæ sponsæ ejus meritórum recordatióne suffúlti: ne repéllas, quǽsumus, suspirántium desidéria animárum, sed præsénti oblatióne ac solemnitáte placátus, tam mirándæ fac nos partícipes sanctitátis. Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Dómine Jesu, panis vitæ, qui Catharínæ Vírgini tuæ indeficiéntis dulcédinis épulas in hac mensa ministrásti: indúlge nobis míseris; ut de micis e tanta ubertáte cadéntibus saturémur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O Lord Jesus, bread of life, who at this table served Your virgin Catherine with meats of unfailing sweetness; be merciful to us wretched sinners,. that we may be filled with the crumbs falling from so plentiful a banquet; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui ad plebem tuam in pace et pietáte firmándam, beátum Guálam Confessórem ac Pontíficem singulári grátia decorásti: ejus nobis intercessióne concéde, ut pacis stúdia operóse sectántes; úberes pietátis fructus percipiámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Hujus immaculátæ hóstiæ oblatióne, et intercessióne beáti Guálæ Confessóris tui, Dómine, tuæ nobis pacis dona largíre. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Bountifully bestow on us, O Lord, the gifts of Your peace, through the offering of this unspotted victim and.the pleading of blessed Guala, Your confessor; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Pane vitæ refécti, te Dómine deprecámur: ut intercedénte beáto Guála Pontífice et Confessóre, ita nos fácias júgiter vívere; ut in éxitu nostro ad te ascéndere valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui per beátum Marcum Confessórem tuum, permúltos errántes in viam iustítiæ redíre fecísti: concéde, ut ejus intercessióne nos quoque a vítiis absolúti; ad ætérna gáudia perveníre felíciter valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who by the ministry of blessed Mark, Your confessor, made many wanderers return to the path of justice; grant by his intercession that we also being cleansed from sin, may happily be able to reach everlasting joy; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Súscipe, clementíssime Dómine, hanc immaculátam hóstiam: et per mérita beáti Marci Confessóris tui, víscera misericórdiæ tuæ super nos effúndere dignéris. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Receive, O most loving Lord, this unspotted victim,...... and through the merits of blessed Mark, Your,('""' confessot;:be pleased to stretch out to us the hand of Your mercy; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Angelórum pane refécti, concéde quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Marci Confessóris tui mónita et exémpla sectémur; ac assídua crucis meditatióne muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui húmilem fámulum tuum Dalmátium multis signis atque virtútibus decorásti; ac mirabíliter in tuo amóre, spretis temporálibus, inflammásti: tríbue nobis, quǽsumus; ut ejus intercessióne, a terrénis afféctibus expedíti, et a cunctis adversitátibus liberáti, sola cæléstia appetámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we pray You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may, for the honor of Your Saints, be pleasing to You and may likewise cleanse us in body and soul; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Dalmátio Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received this heavenly food m;:i.y,through the pleading of blessed Vincent, Your. cdnfessor, be shielded from all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátum Jacóbum Confessórem tuum, humilitátis et obediéntiæ virtúte mirabíliter decorásti: ejus intercessióne fac nos terréna despícere; et mandátis tuis júgiter inhærére: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who wonderfully adorned blessed James, Your confessor, with the virtues of humility and obedience; may we, through his intercession, despise earthly things and always more to cleave to Your commandments; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Oblátis Dómine placáre munéribus: et beáti Jacóbi Confessóris tui intercessióne concéde, ut cæléstia dona digne suscipiéntes, promíssa humílibus prǽmia cónsequi mereámur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Panis Angelórum, quo facis nos esse partícipes: Dómine, súpplices exorámus; ut per beáti Jacóbi mérita, sit nobis salútis ætérnæ indefíciens spes, ac secúra fruítio: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui néminem in te sperántem déseris; et pie deprecántem misericórditer exáudis; tríbue quǽsumus, ut quod nostris méritis non valémus; beátæ Magdalénæ Vírginis patrocínio consequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, You forsake no one who trusts in You, and mercifully hear the prayer of the devout; grarit, we entreat you, that what we cannqt obtain of our ownmerits we may receive through. t)ie help of Your blessed virgin, Magdalene; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Hæc hóstia, Dómine, quam ante thronum divínæ tuæ majestátis offérimus, per beátam Vírginem Magdalénam propitiatória nobis reddátur, et ad cæléstia dona júgiter promerénda idóneos nos reddat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May this victim which we offer before the thron of Your divine majesty, O Lord, be made our propitiation for the sake 9f the blessed virgin Magcla.,. lerie, and ever render us worthy to merit heavenly gifts; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sacra múnera suscépta a futúris nos trahant excéssibus: et beátæ Magdalénæ Vírginis intercessióne gloriósa; Divínæ partícipes natúræ efféctos, tríbuant esse in corde férvidos, et in ópere efficáces: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui fidéles tuos memorántes novíssima, nunquam peccatúros prænuntiásti: fac nos beáti Petri Confessóris tui précibus et exémplis, ita temporálem mortem mente recólere; ut júgiter admíssa peccáta flentes, vitémus ætérnam: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we pray You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may, for the honor of Ypur saints, be pleasing to You, and cleanse us in body and soul; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Petro Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received this heavenly food may, through the pleading of blessed Peter, Your confessor, be shielded from all ills; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui in fídei hóstibus ab errórum ténebris ad veritátis lucem adducéndis, et in pópulis ad pacem et concórdiam revocándis, beátum Bartholomǽum Confessórem tuum atque Pontíficem mirábilem effecísti: ejus intercessióne concéde; ut pax tua, quæ exsúperat omnem sensum, custódiat corda nostra et intelligéntias nostras in Christo Jesu Dómino nostro: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Accépta sit in conspéctu tuo Dómine nostra devótio: ut ejus nobis fiat supplicatióne salutáris, pro cujus solemnitáte defértur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May our devotion be so acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, that at the pleading of him on whose feast day it is offered, it may be an aid to us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Da, quǽsumus Dómine, fidélibus tuis, Sanctórum tuórum semper veneratióne lætári; et eórum perpétua supplicatióne muníri: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant to Your faithful, we beseech You, O Lord, ever to be gladdened by the veneration of Your saints, and to be fortified by their interceding prayer: through out Lord. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui fidélium salúti procurándæ, beátum Damiánum Confessórem tuum, et mira dicéndi vi, et virtútibus decorásti: præsta quǽsumus, ut ejus intercessióne et exémplo; veram caritátem verbo et ópere exhibeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who for the salvation of the faithful adorned blessed Damian, Your confessor, with virtues and powers of speech' alike wondrous, grant, we pray Y qu that through his intercession and example, we may show forth true charity both in word and deed; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Súscipe Dómine hanc hóstiam, quam tibi immolámus: et méritis beáti Damiáni Confessóris tui præsta, ut sicut ipse se tibi in sacrifícium óbtulit, ita nos ad te omnes afféctus cordis dirigámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Sacraméntum Córporis et Sánguinis tui, Dómine, quod súmpsimus, sit fragilitátis nostræ subsídium: ut beátum Damiánum Confessórem tuum imitántes; viam mandatórum tuórum currámus: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May the sacrament of Your body and blood, O Lord, which we have received be the strength of our weakness; that imitating Your blessed confessor, Damian, we may run the way of Your commandments; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Grátiam nobis, Dómine, pœniténtiæ, oratiónis, et humilitátis infúnde: ut beátæ Benvenútæ Vírginis imitatióne possímus, et carnem mortificántes, spíritu vívere; et cæléstia júgiter cogitántes, nosque despiciéntes, in te solo Deo réquiem et glóriam inveníre: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Accépta tibi sit, Dómine, sacrátæ plebis oblátio pro tuórum honóre Sanctórum, quorum se méritis de tribulatióne percepísse cognóscit auxílium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May this offering of Your people be accepted by You, O Lord, for the honor of those Your saints through whose merits they are sensible of having received help in their tribulations; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: ejus, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: You have satisfied Your family, O Lord, with Your gifts; ever re-inflame our zeal by the intercession of him whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátum Simónem Confessórem tuum inter céteras ejus virtútes jugi orándi stúdio, et singulári humilitátis prærogatíva decorásti; ipsum nobis imitári concéde: ut spretis ómnibus, quæ sunt mundi, te hic solum quǽrere; ac tandem promíssa in cælis humílibus prǽmia cónsequi valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

la: Deus, qui beáto Petro fámulo tuo misericórditer tribuísti pro veræ fídei defensióne martýrio coronári: ejus méritis et intercessióne concéde; ut fide, quæ per caritátem operátur, tibi júgiter placére valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who mercifully granted to Your servant, blessed Peter, to be crowned with marytrdom in his defense of the true faith; grant that at his prayers we may be enabled ever to please You by the faith that works through charity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sacrifícium tibi, Dómine, laudis et gratiárum actiónis offeréntes pro victória beáti Petri Mártyris tui, supplíciter deprecámur imménsam bonitátem tuam, ut fidélem pópulum in sancta religióne consérves, et hærética fraude dispérsos ad veritátis tuæ révoces unitátem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui ea ipsa die, qua Unigénitus tuus cum nostræ carnis substántia ab immaculáta Vírgine Matre in templo est præsentátus; ánimam beáti Petri Mártyris in cælum suscepísti: ejus nobis intercessióne concéde, ut in vitæ éxitu divínis mystériis expiáti; in templo glóriæ tuæ præsentári mereámur: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui beátum Joánnem Confessórem tuum plena sui abnegatióne, atque exímiæ caritátis zelo claréscere voluísti: ejus nobis imitatióne concéde; ut abdicátis terrénis afféctibus, in tua dilectióne vivámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God who made blessed John, Your confessor, illustrious by the deepest self-denial and. the utmost zeal for charity; grant us at his example to cast away all affection for things of earth, and to live evermore in Your love; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátam Lúciam, passiónis Fílii tui signáculis mirabíliter decorátam; virginitátis et patiéntiæ donis, blandiéntem mundum elúdere, et persequéntem superáre fecísti: da ut ejus intercessióne et exémplo, nec terrénis vincámur illécebris; nec ullis frangámur advérsis: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

en: You have satisfied Your family, O Lord, with Your gifts; ever re-inflame our zeal by the intercession of him whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beáto Jacóbo Confessóri tuo atque Pontífici ómnia boni pastóris múnia fidéliter explére tribuísti: ejus intercessióne nobis concéde; ut per viam mandatórum tuórum gradiéntes, inter oves páscuæ tuæ perpétuo collocári mereámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Offérimus tibi, Dómine, hóstiam immaculátam, supplíciter deprecántes, ut intercedénte beáto Jacóbo, ab omni labe expurgáti, nos ipsos hóstiam placéntem tibi exhibeámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Intervéniat pro nobis, quǽsumus Dómine, beátus Jacóbus Conféssor et Póntifex: ejúsque précibus concéde; ut cælésti pábulo enutríti, cuncta terréna respuámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui beátum Sebastiánum Confessórem tuum reguláris disciplínæ, et evangélicæ perfectiónis singulári stúdio mirábilem effecísti: concéde propítius, ut ejus imitatióne carne mortificáti, et vivificáti spíritu; ætérna prǽmia consequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

la: Deus, qui gloriósam Matrem tuam nominári Maríam voluísti: concéde quǽsumus, ut qui dulce Maríæ nomen implórant; perpétuum séntiant suæ benedictiónis auxílium: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who willed that Your glorious mother should be called Mary; grant, we beseech You, that whoever calls upon the sweet name of Mary may feel the unfailing help of her blessing: who live. Who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Tua, Dómine, propitiatióne, et beátæ Maríæ semper Vírginis intercessióne, ad perpétuam atque præséntem hæc oblátio nobis profíciat prosperitátem et pacem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: By Your mercy, O Lord, and the pleading of the blessed Mary, ever-virgin, may this offering bring us our prosperity and peace now and forever; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sumptis, Dómine, salútis nostræ subsídiis: da, quǽsumus, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírginis patrocíniis nos ubíque prótegi; in cujus veneratióne hæc tuæ obtúlimus majestáti: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
